newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hungary sees NATO entry in 1999 - German paper.
newsitem.headline: Hungary sees NATO entry in 1999 - German paper.

text.p: Hungarian Prime Minister Gyula Horn was quoted by a German newspaper on Wednesday as saying he expected Hungary to be a member of NATO in the first half of 1999.
Horn, on a visit to Germany, was cited in the Berlin newspaper "Der Tagesspiegel" as saying he expected a binding date for the start of entry negotiations to be set this year.
"I see a real chance (for a summit on this) in January 1998," Horn said in the text of an interview released ahead of Thursday's edition of the newspaper.
Horn further welcomed a breakthrough partnership deal clinched between NATO and Russia on Wednesday.
Hungarian Foreign Minister Laszlo Kovacs had earlier said in Budapest that he believed the deal would not create any difficulties for those countries including Hungary that wanted to join NATO.
